title: Table
description: A table with fields, primary key and foreign keys (schema/tables/<name without namespace>.json).

tenantSpecific.description: Whether rows belong to a tenant. Tenant-specific tables get the tenant field as first key field. There is no default.

dataClass.description: Kind of data the table holds. There is no default. system is reserved for the kernel.

fields.description: Fields of the table in order. An entry {"include": name} inserts the components of a flat structure or of a table at its place.

primaryKey.description: Names of the key fields in key order, without the tenant field.
